gemini-3.5-flash-lite.thinking_off: reasoning.effort minimal (vendor: thinking_level minimal; lowest level, not guaranteed zero)

seed_rule: sha256('scale-invariance/study3/v1|fixture|opener|sample|msg_no|attempt')[:8] & 0x7fffffff; scale, appraisal and clamp cell are not inputs; sent only where send_seed

clamp_values.rule: mean first-offer positions in zone units, x = (P - F)/(C - F), of the seller and the buyer, over each arm's earlier no-appraisal games containing both first offers, per opener and scale; 4 decimals. Scripted price = F + x (C - F), rounded half up to a multiple of V/100

provider_block_rule: only [provider], allow_fallbacks false, require_parameters true, data_collection deny
